t: The Mkeka has a directional facing and can interact with the Kinara, Chalice, and Corn.$(br2)An Mkeka has the capacity to hold a single Kinara, or: $(li)A Chalice by itself $(li)Up to 3 Corn $(li)A combination of a Chalice and up to 3 Corn.
Mkeka具有方向性，可与基纳拉、圣餐杯和玉米互动。$(br2)一个Mkeka最多可放置一件基纳拉，或：$(li)单独放置一个圣餐杯；$(li)最多放置3个玉米；$(li)同时放置一个圣餐杯及最多3个玉米。
To remove objects from the Mkeka, just click on it with an empty hand.
要从麦凯卡上移除物品，只需空手点击它即可。
